answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment rather than ephemeral identity. An attacker attempting to scale across the network must bridge the canyon of prohibitive asset costs, as acquiring sufficient voting power requires exhausting capital reserves. Whether securing a saffron supply chain or a tundra weather oracle, the adversary incurs linear financial risk relative to their influence, rendering identity spoofing economically irrational.
